name: e2e-skills
description: Four agent skills for Playwright and Cypress end-to-end tests: generate new Playwright coverage with live exploration only on local/disposable or externally isolated approved non-production targets, review existing specs or PR diffs, and debug failed runs.

interface.longDescription: AI agent testing toolkit with four skills shared between Claude Code and Codex from ./skills/: playwright-test-generator (live-browser exploration → approval gate → reviewed Playwright tests), e2e-reviewer (static review of Playwright and Cypress specs or PR/diff-scoped test changes against 24 anti-patterns grouped P0/P1/P2 by severity — silent always-pass, poor diagnostics, maintenance), playwright-debugger (root-cause diagnosis from playwright-report/), cypress-debugger (root-cause diagnosis from cypress/reports/ mochawesome or JUnit). Use it for E2E test automation, Playwright test generation, Cypress test review, PR/diff review, flaky test debugging, false-positive detection, and test smell scanning. Includes a standalone scanner (skills/e2e-reviewer/scripts/scan.sh) for CI use without an agent runtime.
defaultPrompt: Generate Playwright E2E tests with live-browser exploration and approval gate.
Review existing Playwright/Cypress specs or PR/diff-scoped test changes for 24 P0/P1/P2 anti-patterns.
Diagnose failed Playwright/Cypress tests with root-cause classification.
